verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official MCP server (docs.stripe.com/mcp) that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API and documentation, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit, which would let an agent access Terminal-related API functionality. However, evidence doesn't show Terminal-specific MCP tools (e.g., reader management, in-person payment flows) explicitly exposed, only the general Stripe API/knowledge-base MCP server. Missing for 10: Terminal-specific MCP tool documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of agent-Terminal interaction via MCP.
